problem:
What is the area scale factor of the linear transformation $T$ that is given by its standard matrix 

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}8 & -2 \\ -2 & 1\end{aligned}]?
$$

activity_context.topic_title: Area Scale Factors of Linear Transformations

examples.knowledge_point: Computing the Area Scale Factor of a Linear Transformation
examples.problem:
What is the area scale factor of the linear transformation $\mathbf{T}$ that is given by its standard matrix 
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14095768/assets/4dbe8f14fe2189749e753080658086e4b7f608a5b7028151d2464b99be4a29ed.png)
examples.worked_solution:
The area scale factor of a linear transformation $\mathbf T$ with standard matrix $T$ is equal to $|\det(T)|.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}|det(T)| & =|2\cdot 4-3\cdot 1| \\  & =|8-3| \\  & =5.\end{aligned}
$$
